text:
Sam: Quick huddle  need to lock 2 priorities for Optimize this sprint. Customer asks: (1) live batching & cache hints in Console, (2) eval-triggered regression alerts, (3) quantization recommendation engine. Thoughts?
Lee: lean into (1) + (2). Hints give immediate cost wins; alerts buy trust.
Anita: agree with Lee. For alerts we must avoid noise  need explicit signal spec + debouncing.
Maya: on calls AcmeHealth/Nimbus said theyll only adopt alerts if FP rate is low and there's a human confirm step.
Carlos: quant recs need a benchmarking harness and staged canary infra; risky to attempt full rollout this sprint. Recommend research spike only.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: optimize-console-hints v2 -> staging :rocket:
Sam: propose MVP definitions so Eng can scope:
- Hints MVP: per-route batching recommendation (top 3 routes), one-click cache TTL preset, estimated token-cost delta.
- Alerts MVP: eval-driven alerts for concordance drop OR embedding drift, behind feature flag, with 24h quiet window and manual confirm.
Lee: rough sizing: Hints ~6 dev-days if limited surface; Alerts ~8 dev-days leveraging existing eval infra + throttle.
Anita: signal proposal: concordance drop >=7% OR mean embedding cosine drop >=0.06 over 2+ consecutive eval runs triggers alert. Add opt-in "confirm before notify" checkbox.
Maya: will run this by customers and prefer default to confirmed-only.
Carlos: add SLI: pilot false-positive rate <10%. Also need rollback plan for noisy alerts.
Sam: decision: ship Hints as top priority + lightweight Alerts behind FF for pilot. Defer quant recs to next sprint as research. Any objections?
Lee: none. I'll open tickets: OPT-220 (console-batching-hints-top3), OPT-221 (cache-ttl-presets-and-cost-estimate), OPT-222 (eval-alerts-ff-pilot).
Anita: I'll draft the signal thresholds doc and seed eval examples. snippet for tests:
```
# alert config (pseudo)
alert_type: concordance_regression
threshold: 0.07
min_consecutive_runs: 2
quiet_window: 24h
notify_mode: confirmed_only
```
Carlos: timeline ok? aiming for internal pilot by EOW next week.
Lee: ack, will attach PR plan to tickets.
Maya: I'll invite AcmeHealth to pilot and collect acceptance criteria (low noise, clear remediation steps).
Sam: Action items: Lee tickets + PR, Anita signal doc + sample evals, Maya customer pilot roster, Carlos SLI/monitoring + rollback plan. Reconvene Wed for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
